title: Cartwise+ Membership Term Value Run for Long-Standing Members
content:
When a Cartwise+ Membership moves from Cartwise+ Annual to Cartwise+ Monthly on a pause request, the value of the annual term already run is measured for a long-standing member as follows.

**(a) Recent switch — whole weeks.** A member whose enrollment date is at least 18 months back and whose plan switch into the annual term took effect fewer than 3 whole months ago has it counted in whole weeks: the annual plan's period fee multiplied by the whole weeks run multiplied by 7, divided by the days in the term.

**(b) Earlier switch — months started.** A member whose enrollment date is at least 18 months back and whose plan switch into the annual term took effect 3 or more whole months ago has it counted in months started: the annual plan's period fee multiplied by the months of the term started, the month in progress included, divided by 12.

**(c)** For any other member, neither (a) nor (b) applies.

## Decision table

| Enrollment date at least 18 months back | Whole months since the plan switch took effect | Value already run |
|---|---|---|
| yes | fewer than 3 | fee multiplied by whole weeks run multiplied by 7, divided by the days in the term |
| yes | 3 or more | fee multiplied by months of the term started, divided by 12 |
| no | any | not measured under (a) or (b) |

## Terms used

- **Whole weeks run.** The calendar days from the term's first day up to the day before today, divided by 7, with any part week dropped.
- **Months of the term started.** A month of the term starts on the same day of the month as the term's first day; the month in progress counts.
- **Days in the term.** The calendar days from the term's first day up to the day before the term ends.
- **Records.** The enrollment date and the plan-switch date on the membership record, each counted in whole months up to today.

## Hypothetical illustrations (annual fee 99.00, term from 10 January, 365 days)

- **(a)** Today 25 March, switch on 10 January (2 whole months ago): 74 days run, which is 10 whole weeks, or 70 days; value already run is 99.00 multiplied by 70, divided by 365, which is 18.9863….
- **(b)** Today 15 April, switch on 10 January (3 whole months ago): months started are those beginning 10 January, 10 February, 10 March and 10 April, which is 4; value already run is 99.00 multiplied by 4, divided by 12, which is 33.00.
